svg.title: TYPE_CHARGE_PAYLOAD -> PlanChargePayloadJob()
svg.desc: Charge an electric car. If its tray is not already on a ready VECS, find one, plan the tray move, then switch the VECS to CHARGING.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Find the car and the tray it is on. In this example: The car is on T20 at P20. (found)", "Row 3. If the tray already sits on an EV charging node whose VECS is ready, no move is needed. In this example: P20 is plain parking. (no)", "Row 4. Otherwise search for a reachable VECS spot, reusing the open-space search of ResolveBlockingTrays. In this example: The open-space search only accepts a spot with a VECS for an EV-charge payload (OpenSpaceSearchEnvironment): V23 here. (dest = V23)", "Row 5. The search must have found a node, and that node must have a VECS (an EV_CHARGE node). In this example: V23 is a VECS. (passes)", "Row 6. Plan the tray onto the VECS (reuses PlanReparkTrayJob). In this example: UseEvChargeHeading only matters on 576_eccles. Adds the TrayMove with rule A (T20); rule C would wait for V23's last event (none yet). (adds 1)", "Row 7. Start charging once the tray is there. In this example: Starts after the tray arrives. (adds 2 \u00b7 B)"]
